Name: Shields Down
Effect: Only Minior can use this Ability. After reaching half or less of its HP in battle, replace Minior with Minior (Core Form) at full HP. While in Core Form this Pokémon is Immune to Status Ailments. Restore Minior to its base Form at the end of the Battle. Unique Ability.
Description: The Pokémon's core is protected by a sturdy shield, if the shield is shattered the Pokémon starts acting crazy.
